text:
Sam K: kicking off blue->green for router eu-west1: v2.3.1 -> v2.4-candidate. Plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 6m waits. Change window 22:30-23:30 UTC. Pin v2.3.1 as fallback. @Priya R @Lee W ack and monitor.

Priya R: ack. spinning up canary probe; watching p50/p95 and auth paths.

Lee W: ack. watching edge drain. pause if errors +2% or p95 +5%.

Sam K: warmed pool and deployed canary.
```
infractl pool create router-v2-4-canary --region eu-west1 --size 3
infractl deploy --svc router --img redwood/router:v2.4-cand --pool router-v2-4-canary
```

deploy-bot: weight update: 0% -> 10% to v2.4-cand applied.

OpsOnCall: initial monitors OK.

Priya R: probe shows p95 +2.3% and TTFB blip for hot keys.

Emily G: increased KV misses on canary; shard config differs.

Lee W: pause and run targeted cache-warm.

Sam K: pausing ramp and running cache-warm.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp paused by Sam K.

OpsOnCall: cache-warm completed; p95 back ~+0.7%.

Sam K: manual bump to 25%.

deploy-bot: weights now v2.3.1=75%, v2.4-cand=25%.

Emily G: at 25% auth 5xx spiked ~1.2% concentrated on token validation.

Priya R: traced to signing lib default timeouts; applying config override to canary and restart.

Sam K: apply override and rolling restart.

deploy-bot: config patch applied; rolling restart succeeded.

OpsOnCall: auth 5xx fell to 0.2%, p95 ~+1.0%.

Sam K: propose abort tonight's ramp and rollback to stable; keep canary for 24h diagnostics; cut v2.4.1 with fixes.

Lee W: +1 prefer patch and pin.

Emily G: opening image ticket RB-4821; aim for tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: rollback weights to stable: v2.3.1=100%, v2.4-cand=0% ... succeeded. Draining canary pool.

Priya R: drafting release note: "Canary v2.4 paused and rolled back due to cache warm and signing timeout mismatch. Actions: extend signing.timeout, add cache-warm to deploy flow, cut v2.4.1 and retest."

Sam K: closing this thread for tonight. Will reconvene tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
